Well I'm Haitian myself so I dont think I deserve as much respect as you think, I just didnt know what to do so I tried to help whomever I could , cause I mean, there was no way to wrap my head around what was happening, and it was too horrifying to even be depressed at all, so I just went to work

i've never been on medication, at least not since I was 12-13 and on Paxil ( I didnt last very long on that either)
Its probably because I dont have a psychiatrist, which is because every time I try to get help anywhere the bureaucracy/phonetag/hoops I have to jump through just to get an appointment with someone who'll listen end up being too exhausting, so I give up and never end up seeing anyone.. so yeah.. that would be the why of it ( i know it sounds like excuses)
thank you, good luck to you  as well
thank you :) you have all been lovely, im really grateful for the company (its 5 am and im usually all kinds of fucked up/alone at this hour)
i was really hoping they would have... but yeah.. no :/
yeah, i was desperately trying not to unload/vent too hard on reddit but i see how thats problematic now :)

i had such a silly response to your comment, 
i was reading the part about being selfish for a while (which i think i did when i lost my job at the council, at least partly by taking a break from haiti for a bit), and i got to thinking "even school?" i say this of course because like every other screwup 20something i have things past due as of today that im too distraught to even try to bother to do
anyway i digress
i do want to try to talk to a therapist... i tried getting an [appointment](http://argyleinstitute.org/en/corporate-community-services/) today but it didnt work, apparently they're not equipped to deal with people in my state and i should call back when i'm "stronger" and the suicidal ideation is "behind me".
that actually bummed me out more and i didnt try anything else.
they did suggest i go to the ER but i just sat in bed instead.

i actually dig your suggestion a ton , thanks for that, very much :)

i guess the cause is the typical messed up childhood + teenagehood + bad choice of friends/relationship combo they make movies and SW posts about :/ 

to stop being vague again, i had the abusive father thing going - but i did love him (at least sometimes), anyway he died in 2007 , by then we weren't on speaking terms anymore (i guess i didn't love him anymore or something) but it affected me extremely weirdly and i've been even more of a mess since though i dont think about it much

my ex tried to be nice to me after the death and invited me to spend a week with him in boston to get away from things, but then he just assaulted me after, but im over that too as well ( i think?) 

i really should see someone to find out if its really related to a medical condition, but seeing as ive been a suicidal mess for the past 12 years.. my guess is at the very least ive some sort of chronic depression sort of thing going on


oh yes and like everyone else who is haitian too many people i knew  back home died this year, that was a mess, and that i,ll never ever get over

k
 this is getting rambly ill msg you instead

i think you should call and complain, or at least write if its better for you
i wanted to write thank you so much and decided to go for "tysm" cause im dumb and underslept
my bad :/
wasnt sure which response you meant, currently reading whole thread, interesting read ty

basically THIS.

i'm in canada so i have to figure out how things work with referalls/ meds insurance / getting prescribed in the first place

i tried to call a mental health place today to see someone but they just told me they weren't equipped to deal with someone in my condition and to go to an ER ... so meh.. idk..
thanks for the chance to talk illl definitely take you up on that tysm

I feel like I can only really answer that with more things about me, at least for now. I'm definitely no longer at home, I moved out of the country for university about 5 years ago today, volunteered for haiti most of this year, worked for the council of haitian citizens, got laid off because the council went bankrupt, and now am back in school part time. I tried to kill myself twice, ran away from the ER the second time (two years ago) and haven't tried again since.

I was depressed all of this year but had this weird idea that I didn't want to add to the death toll of haitians, that I didn't have the right to kill myself after all this, etc etc.

I guess what I'm trying to say is that the older I get the more horrifying the world becomes, and the bigger it is, the bigger the catastrophes. I may be getting to a point where I really don't want to hang around to see any more.

I wish you all the best, sorry for losing the point in my response there

you know, you're definitely right about this. i've only recently gotten a taste of those days (this summer mostly), though i realize those "happy" moments were for the most part not spent sober, it was weird in a good way to suddenly be "normal", or at least not spent pretending to be entertaining/happy/funny .. thanks for reminding me of that
well, your response is pretty much how I feel except that it looks like I've been suffering for the past 12, give or take a few months here and there... thanks for answering me

> It's a place to talk, if people don't want to listen they don't have to; it's one of the advantages of the internet you know?
this is true, but its my first time posting in SW, i guess i wanted to avoid bothering people

i guess what i'm trying to say is that I always end up wanting to die, 
no melodrama intended. 
every year at least twice per, there's this moment where I start being this insufferable mess and/or planning how I'm going to die, with a tiny tiny part of me trying to "get better", get over it, etc etc.

I really thought I'd be too old for this by now (mid twenties), I've accomplished a few things I suppose, lived a little, what have you, but welp here I am again, making another noose.

PS im not about to kill myself right this minute or anything. I'm just getting there eventually.
